channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: South Korea and Brazil sign deals on K-beauty, trade
item.description: SEOUL: Brazilians could more easily get their hands on coveted “K-beauty” products under a deal struck Monday during President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva’s state visit to South Korea.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Zubir Khan delighted to meet idol Ajith Kumar
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: It was a star-struck moment for popular Tamil singer Zubir Khan when he crossed paths with legendary Indian actor Ajith Kumar at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA) in Sepang recently.

item.title: Odd-job worker faces 12 charges for allegedly raping, sexually assaulting stepdaughter
item.description: MUAR: A 40-year-old odd-job worker was charged in the Sessions Court today with 12 counts of raping and sexually assaulting his 14-year-old stepdaughter.

item.title: Iranian President orders 'comprehensive investigation' into anti-government protests
item.description: ISTANBUL: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has ordered a “comprehensive and impartial investigation” into incidents that occurred during anti-government protests in January, Anadolu Ajansi reported.

item.title: Wolves, Sunderland condemn racist abuse directed at players
item.description: LONDON: Wolverhampton Wanderers and Sunderland said they were appalled by the racial abuse directed at their players on social media on Sunday following defeats in the Premier League.

item.title: Vietjet seals RM24.6bil deals to boost Malaysia-Vietnam and regional connectivity
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Vietjet has signed strategic agreements worth about RM24.57 billion with corporations and financiers from the United States (US) to expand seat capacity and strengthen connectivity between Malaysia, Vietnam and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

item.title: Asia trade corridors surge as supply chains realign, says Citigroup
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Trade corridors across Asia are expanding at a rapid pace as global supply chains undergo a significant realignment, according to Citigroup.

item.title: From 'breath of fresh air' to 'gale' as Ashwad takes over RTM
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The previous director-general of broadcasting at Radio Televisyen Malaysia came with a “breath of fresh air”, but now the Communications Ministry wants to turn that breath into a “gale”.

item.title: AC Milan's Loftus-Cheek to undergo surgery after jaw fracture - report
item.description: MILAN: England international Ruben Loftus-Cheek suffered a fractured jaw and will undergo surgery after the AC Milan midfielder collided with Parma keeper Edoardo Corvi in their Serie A match on Sunday, Italian media reported.

item.title: Putin says developing Russia's nuclear forces 'absolute priority'
item.description: MOSCOW: President Vladimir Putin said Sunday that developing Russia’s nuclear forces was now an “absolute priority” following the expiry of its last remaining nuclear treaty with the US.
